This supports the expert hint to scrutinize the grounding. Additionally, the plumage texture on the lower belly is somewhat smooth/plastic-like compared to the detailed wings, suggesting a minor generation inconsistency in feather rendering. These issues are subtle but warrant a slight deduction from the base artifact score.
